summary: std/archive untar: an old GNU sparse map longer than 1 MiB is "archive/tar: sparse map too long", as Go 1.26.11, where every extended block was read
details: an old GNU sparse map longer than 1 MiB is "archive/tar: sparse map too long", as Go 1.26.11, where every extended block was read. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/archive untar, native backends): an old GNU sparse map longer than 1 MiB is "archive/tar: sparse map too long", as Go 1.26.11, where every extended block was read. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
